image_description: An underwater photograph featuring a lionfish (Pterois) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins, and elongated dorsal spines. The background consists of yellow sponge-like coral structures and blue water.
